description: Practical guidance for designing, operating, and troubleshooting Ruflo agent-harness workflows, swarms, memory, MCP setup, and safety controls.

interface.defaultPrompt: Help me plan or troubleshoot a Ruflo workflow. Establish the goal and constraints, choose the smallest suitable agent setup, give commands grounded in the current Ruflo documentation, and define verification and safety checks.
interface.longDescription: A workflow guide for using Ruflo responsibly: plan agent swarms, configure local MCP access, structure memory and retrieval, verify work, and apply security controls. It provides guidance and commands, not a live Ruflo connection.

name: ruflo-agent-harness
